engine: node and gradle on the sherlo checkout (ANDROID_HOME set)

reporterSaw.words: A sherlo helper that changes the SDK's Android Java cannot compile it or run its Java unit tests, because no department verb reaches gradle.

check: cmd=$(node -p "require('./package.json').scripts['test:android-sdk'] || ''"); test -n "$cmd" || { echo 'no test:android-sdk script in the root package.json'; exit 1; }; sh -c "$cmd"
